note: The client's WhatsApp export of the night of 5 Sep 2026 — 664 photographs sent between 19:19 and 23:40, covering 18 team blocks. Unlike the 0904 batches this one is a catalogue dump: one photograph per garment, not an album of views per garment. Roughly 650 distinct garments, about the size of the whole store before it.
identificationMethod: The client sends a bare team name as a text message immediately before each team's block, then one album per garment type with a one-word caption ('retro', 'fan version', 'player version', 'kids set', 'half zip', 'full zip', 'hoodie', 'training set', 'windbreaker'). Captions were read off WhatsApp Web on 6 Sep 2026 and aligned to the export cumulatively — see scripts/align-0905.mjs, which bound all 664 photographs to a caption and a team with zero drift across 101 albums. The garment itself (club, season, kit slot, sleeve length) is then read by eye off contact sheets; the caption supplies only the tier and the team.
photoPolicy: One photograph per listing. The client's own standing rule is that a listing should carry more than one image, and this is a deliberate, owner-approved exception for this batch (6 Sep 2026) so the stock goes live; topping the galleries up from the supplier albums is a separate job.

tierNotes.retroTop: The client priced this themselves at 23:34 — 'retro training top R1000'. Real Madrid's 19:20 album is captioned 'retro half zip' with no price; a retro half-zip IS a retro training top, so it is priced at R1000 here too. FLAG FOR CLIENT — if they meant the ordinary R850 half-zip tier, five Real Madrid listings are R150 over.
tierNotes.fullZip: 'Full-zip tracksuit / jacket or windbreaker only' is R1000 on the client's 27 Aug list. A full windbreaker tracksuit or Chinese New Year jacket is R1200 and is NOT covered by this tier — check the garment before using it.
tierNotes.trainingSet: The 27 Aug price list carries both 'training top and shorts R600' and 'adults sets top and shorts training R700' and the client has never resolved which applies. R600 is used here, consistent with the rest of the catalogue.

orderNote: Teams are run biggest catalogue gap first (batch photographs minus listings already live), so the most under-stocked team lands first and the run can be stopped at any team boundary.
